CD-M1.title: Rule 14.144's R-38 state draws a connection R-38 does not target.
CD-M1.what_and_fix: Where: `s-14-144-correct`, from `phase3_ch14_complex_build.py`. What: `.sv .crt .ak-case{stroke:var(--oa-color-graphic-essential);stroke-width:6px}` applies to L39's group at all times; each "unchosen reform" rule resets `.ak-mark` to 2 px but never resets `.ak-case`, so with R-38 checked L39 draws as a 6 px black stroke, heavier than any other line (seen in `states/s-14-144-correct--R-38.png`). Fix: add `.ak-case{stroke:none}` to each `.p:has([value="R-nn"]:checked) [data-oa-for]:not([data-oa-for~="R-nn"])` rule, or move the case into the checked rules as 15.20 does; recapture all three states on both grounds. Owner: complex examples maker; component engineer reads it; data lead signs off.
CD-M1.owner: complex examples maker; component engineer reads it; data lead signs off

CD-M2.title: Rule 15.22's veto stage splits two sentences into columns.
CD-M2.what_and_fix: Where: `s-15-22-correct`, stage 10, from `phase3_ch15_build.py` (`.wf .sq{display:flex;gap:8px}`). What: "Short of", the `nw2` span "two-thirds" and "in either chamber, the bill dies." become three flex items, and "With two-thirds in each, then stage 13." prints with two 8 px gaps. Two lines in the guide, both here (counted by script over every `s-15-*` specimen). Fix: wrap the text after the marker in one span (`Short of two-thirds ...`), rerun the brace check and recapture 15.22 at 1440, 390 and 320 px. Owner: systems designer.

CD-M3.title: DR-278 (b) for the trackers.
CD-M3.what_and_fix: Where: `s-11-10-*`, `s-11-11-*`, `s-11-12-*` and every `role="img"` stage the fix reaches. What: the words inside the stage are heard after its alt. Fix: `aria-hidden` on the stage's fragment in `plate()`, as DR-278 sets, with the accessibility reader's reach count. Owner: engineer (`guide_build.py`), with the accessibility lead.

4. The selection guide at true size: at 1x at 390 px the forms read apart by shape in every family but maps, where three symbols read as texture; avoid forms are struck in mark and named "Avoid" in words. The capture cuts at 5,548 px at 1440 px, so the last group I read at 390 px.

Weight, from the build report: page 12,107,102 bytes, projection 15,117,621 of 15,500,000 with Phase 4's seven chapters at 362,857 each; chapter 14 at 2,072,555 plus the kit (565,548) and geometry, 120,739 past its figure by the build's count; selection guide 149,403; palette plate 69,443; 14.142 to 14.144 at 32,433, 43,078 and 55,628; chapter 15 at 562,202 of 600,000; chapter 11 at 500,801 of 550,000. finished_chapters_verdict: Chapter 15, yes, once CD-M2 lands: it reads as a chapter a design firm would sign, with one idea a reader keeps (follow a mechanism one connection at a time, and never claim a strength the model lacks) and a back half that turns the atlas's routes into sourced workflows. Chapter 14, yes in structure and in its finest plates; it ships once CD-M1 and CD-S1 land, and it stays long (a reader needs "Choose a chart" and the local contents to move through it).

risks_for_dustin: Rule 15.22's three examples of undoing a law (a sunset in Public Law 115-97, NRSC v. FEC, a change in Public Law 119-21) each come from one side's legislation or one side's win.
